text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ugh… I really want to stuff myself silly with something sweet…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: A manju with a thin skin and jam-packed with red bean paste would be great…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Some yokan would be yummy as well… But ohagi sounds good too…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …I'll go out and buy some. I can't be bothered to make them from scratch now…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O seems rather fatigued. Looks like I need to rethink her race schedule.
